title: Name Changes in Non-Jurisdictional Corporate Bodies
summary: For works about non-jurisdictional corporate bodies that have changed name (linear changes, mergers, splits), assign the heading for the name used during the latest period covered by the work, and also headings for earlier names that are prominently featured. Applies also to non-jurisdictional bodies tagged 151. Incidental mention of a recent period is not coverage of it.
validation_rules: For a work about a non-jurisdictional corporate body that has changed its name, assign the heading for the name used by the body during the latest period covered by the work. (H 460 sec. 1)
An incidental reference to a recent period does not constitute coverage of that period; do not assign the later name(s) in that case. (H 460 sec. 1)
If an earlier name is prominently featured in the work, also assign the heading for the earlier name. (H 460 sec. 2)
These principles apply equally to non-jurisdictional corporate bodies tagged 151 (e.g., `Buckley Air Force Base (Colo.)`). (H 460, Background)

sections.heading: 1. Assignment of name for latest period covered
sections.text:
Assign the heading for the name used by the body during the latest period covered by the work being cataloged.

Note: Do not construe an incidental reference to a recent period as being "coverage" of that period. For example, a work about the New York Central Railroad published in 1985 that mentions only briefly in the closing chapter the railroad's absorption into Amtrak and ConRail would not be considered to "cover" the recent period and would not be assigned the headings for Amtrak and ConRail. Only the heading for the New York Central Railroad would be assigned.

sections.heading: 2. Assignment of earlier names
sections.text: If an earlier name is prominently featured in the work being cataloged, assign the heading for the earlier name as well. For example, an up-to-date history of the Ringling Bros. Barnum & Bailey Circus that prominently features the histories of its predecessors, the Ringling Bros. Circus and the Barnum and Bailey Circus, would be assigned the heading for its latest name, *Ringling Brothers Barnum and Bailey Combined Shows*, as well as the headings *Ringling Brothers* and *Barnum and Bailey*.
